notes.title: New optimization update for ROM
notes.content:
Hey Extractors,

We’ve been out in the world showcasing ROM at events like GDC, SXSW, Pax East, and VRLA--and now we’re back with an update for you. Thanks for all your patience and feedback! Check out the following ROM update notes we have for you today:

1. Various performance optimizations.
2. Various audio improvements.
3. Improved default graphics setting detection.
4. Overrun level lighting improvements.
5. Bug fix: fullscreen performance issue.

As always, we appreciate your comments on the discussion board. You may now return to your general badass-ery, Extractor.

-- First Contact team 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27029644/4c20a343084e07d6a0f116b69d1a049c6315fda4.jpg

notes.title: Hotfix for Overrun update
notes.content:
Hey all, 
The hotfix is now live! It mainly addresses the framerate issues some players were experiencing upon release of our new Overrun update. Notes below:

1.  Improved graphics settings auto detection (accessible through "Graphics Settings" -> "Restore Defaults”) to ensure framerates at default settings.  
2.  Clear previously saved graphics options to address saved options on some systems negatively impact framerates due to game rendering pipeline upgrade from deferred renderer to forward renderer.
3. Fixed issue with Overrun social screen.
4. Level lighting improvements.

Your robot-annihilation should be smooth sailing from here on out, Extractors! And of course, if you have any further issues please ping us on the discussion board.

-- First Contact team

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27029644/11ffd9add13362eb77d384c8e0cd08bc38727c64.jpg

notes.title: The Overrun expansion is now live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27029644/d378215af79d27d83a99780b3b54a83a3d33976e.jpg

Heads up Extractors!  

We’re excited to announce that the first content expansion for ROM: Extraction is now live! Overrun is a whole new level for players to master, featuring several crazy new twists on VR gameplay.

After narrowly escaping the attack on the chamber, your journey to the escape pods continues through the depths of the extraction vessel. The ship has been overrun! Systems are malfunctioning, and now you must face new enemies on the lower levels of the ship and escape to the planet surface with your life.

New Features:  


 Experience increased intensity in this continuation of the ROM story
 Battle against enemies in dynamic, interactive locations 
 Enemies exhibit new, highly dangerous behaviors
 Use the environment to your advantage--be on the lookout for destructibles
 New leaderboards for each game mode
 Featuring the track “Kill Room” by drum & bass duo Delta Heavy


And of course...the EOS-15!   


 A brand new two-handed plasma rifle with orb-launching capabilities
 Grab the EOS-15 when you shoot the floating gun power-up token
 Use the EOS-15 to “Launch, Slow, Shoot”--a new twist on the core game mechanic that gives you an orb-launching, auto-firing weapon of destruction 
 When “jumpers” are in close proximity, use your pistol or EOS-15 to pop off their heads!


Full Patch Notes:  


New level - Overrun
Audio volume adjustment
New music - “Kill Room” by Delta Heavy
Updated animation sets
New Hit reaction animations
New Fire stance animations
EOS-15 two-handed rifle via power up token
Robot head decapitation of jumpers
Jumping suicide-robot AI type (beware!)
Updated front end environment
New leaderboard for Overrun level
Widescreen output for better recording/streaming (when social screen is disabled)
Improvements in framerate optimization—in ROM’s graphical settings, users can opt for MSAA instead of TAA (Temporal AA), increasing GPU frame time by 25%. MSAA bringing additional crispness to the rendering.
